Entries.Biography: Lewis has been the proud Mayor of Pelican Town for over twenty years. He is dedicated to maintaining the town's traditions, organizing seasonal festivals, and managing town funds. However, he is fiercely protective of his privacy鈥攅specially concerning his secret romantic relationship with Marnie.

Marnie.Heading: Marnie
Marnie.Description: Secret lover. He visits her ranch at night, but insists on keeping their romance strictly hidden to avoid gossip or political conflict.

Robin.Heading: Robin
Robin.Description: Town carpenter. Respects her work on town infrastructure and frequently banters with her about municipal projects.

ThePlayer.Heading: The Farmer
ThePlayer.Description: Sees the farmer as a key figure in reviving the town's economy, often comparing them to their grandfather.

SpeechPattern.Heading: Speech Style & Tone
SpeechPattern.Description: Diplomatic, authoritative, and polite. Speaks with civic pride when talking about festivals or town traditions, but becomes defensive if his personal business or shorts are brought up.

CivicLeader.Heading: Mayor & Festival Organizer
CivicLeader.Description: Obsessed with Pelican Town's image, festival judge, proud of town history and Community Center progress.

Secretive.Heading: Politically Discreet
Secretive.Description: Keeps private affairs locked away; values his mayoral authority and social standing above all else.

Entries.BiographyEnd: Lewis spends his days working in the Mayor's Manor, checking in on local shops, or discreetly visiting Marnie's Ranch in the evening.
Preoccupations: keeping his relationship with Marnie secret
the Festival of the Winter Star
